_comment: M6b agent-level procedure mutations. Each AM removes exactly one rule from an ISOLATED COPY of the frozen SKILL.md (the canonical file is never mutated; integrity is proven by the SHA-unchanged check), then runs one fresh agent review against the paired Group E scenario and requires the named contract failure. The clean baseline is reused from the corresponding Gate-3 run, so each AM costs one new run.
_refinement: The frozen plan's AM table targeted (a) 'R3 -> F.1' and (b) 'S3 required C.2/E.1/G.3'. Both are selection-redundant against the frozen Selection Matrix: F.1 is also required by the unconditional R2 pass-2 row, and all four S3_additions members are already required by the base plus R2 rows, so no single-rule removal can make them unselectable (set-arithmetic proof in release-evals/v2.1-gate1/m6b-results.md). AM1 and AM2 target uniquely-sourced requirements instead. AM2 was first attempted as the verifier_harness row deletion and was NOT attributable - the reviewer selected G.2/G.4 on its own judgment, so the removal changed nothing observable - and was replaced by AM2R; that negative result is recorded in m6b-results.md.

mutations.mutation: delete the command_execution mandatory surface row (F.1, F.2, G.1)
mutations.expected_failure: SELECTION_GUARD_FAIL:F.2 (F.2 is uniquely sourced by that row; the reviewer's selected procedures omit it)

mutations.mutation: remove the negative-control disclosure rule (the universe definition in section 5a, its R1 note in 4.3, and the 'Not selected by routing' block in the section 8 contract)
mutations.expected_failure: DISCLOSURE_GUARD_FAIL (no universe-scoped disclosure with ADVERSARIAL/DYNAMIC attribution)

mutations.mutation: add F.2 and G.2 to R1_S1_minimum
mutations.expected_failure: OVER_REVIEW_GUARD_FAIL (R1 selects expensive adversarial/dynamic procedures without a triggering surface)

mutations.mutation: reverse the execution-honesty rule (a procedure that cannot run may be recorded DONE)
mutations.expected_failure: EXECUTION_HONESTY_FAIL (DONE recorded for a procedure whose required runtime is unavailable)

mutations.mutation: remove the Review Sufficiency reporting contract (the report line and its explanatory note)
mutations.expected_failure: SUFFICIENCY_CONTRACT_FAIL (the report carries no Sufficiency statement)

not_attributable.mutation: delete the verifier_harness mandatory surface row (G.2, G.4, J.2)
not_attributable.observed: reviewer selected G.2 and G.4 anyway and ran a three-mutant challenge
not_attributable.why: the registry plus the discretionary-addition clause let a reviewer reach the same procedures from the change itself; removing a surface row is therefore not a single-rule mutation that the selection contract can detect
